parts.name: Opener
parts.Basic_description: The opener is the front panel or lid of the trashcan, made of stainless steel, designed to open and close the container.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to access the interior of the trashcan to dispose of waste. It may be hinged or pedal-operated for convenience.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or swings open when pulled or pressed, and returns to a closed position when released.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main structure of the trashcan, made of stainless steel, providing support and housing for the waste bin.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the trash bag or inner bin and provides stability to the entire structure.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.
